home.headline: Mechanical watches, serviced by hand.
home.subheadline: Three generations at the same bench on Wickenden Street. We service, restore and size fine mechanical watches, and we'll tell you honestly what yours needs.
home.final_heading: Bring it in. We'll take a look while you wait.

items.name: Full service
items.description: Movement disassembled, cleaned, oiled and regulated, with a water test and a two-year warranty.

items.name: Restoration
items.description: Vintage pieces brought back carefully, keeping original dials and hands wherever we can.

items.name: Crystals & bracelets
items.description: Sapphire crystals, links, sizing and clasps, usually the same day.

about.heading: Sixty years at one bench.
paragraphs: Frank Halloran opened the shop in 1962 after an apprenticeship in Biel. His daughter Maureen and granddaughter Clare run it now.

testimonials.quote: Clare brought my grandfather's watch back to life and kept every scratch that mattered.
testimonials.author: Sean B.
